headline: KC (PROP) jumps +50.00% on strong volume while XBIO (FOOD) sees a +16.67% price gap and files a disposal notice.
market_take: Property stocks led the market with several double‑digit moves, notably KC (+50.00%) and PF (+25.00%). Food sector showed mixed signals: XBIO rallied +33.33% with a price gap and filing, whereas ITC slipped -4.73% amid a volume spike. Cons and PF&REIT had modest gains but notable unusual trades and filings, while AGRI saw suspension activity.
